name: XENO STORE
author: XENOKING
description: PS5 game store + download manager by XENOKING. Serves the store on :9095, keeps downloading while the browser is closed, auto-installs PKGs, backs up saves and more.

payloads.name: XENO STORE
payloads.notes: Server only. Open http://<ps5-ip>:9095 (or http://xeno.local:9095) in the PS5 browser or on your phone. Recommended for Payload Manager auto-start.

payloads.name: XENO STORE (opens browser)
payloads.notes: Same server, and it opens the PS5 web browser straight to the store. Pick this one when sending the payload by hand.
